_note: Founding tasks, in order (docs/02-progression.md). Players see one at a time and claim the reward (added to the colony they pick) once its goal is met. goal is one of: { chamber, level } (that chamber at that level in any colony), { units, count } (that many of a caste, home or away), { missionSent } (a mission of that type ever sent), { wildRaidsWon } (that many raids won against wild ant nests). milestone: the big-moment text shown for this task. screen: where the Show me button goes.

quests.title: Build a Leaf Garden
quests.hint: Foliage is the colony’s building material.

quests.title: Build a Nursery
quests.hint: Production chambers need workers to run them. The Nursery raises them.

quests.title: Enlarge the Queen's Chamber to level 2
quests.hint: Each level of the Queen’s Chamber unlocks new chambers.

quests.title: Grow your Leaf Garden to level 3
quests.hint: A bigger economy makes everything after this faster.

quests.title: Enlarge the Queen's Chamber to level 3
quests.hint: Level 3 lets the colony herd aphids.

quests.title: Discover Nectar
quests.hint: Build an Aphid Pasture. Aphids give honeydew — Nectar — which castes, research and every journey need.

quests.title: Build a Brood Hall
quests.hint: Castes and defenses are raised in the Brood Hall.

quests.title: Raise 3 Workers
quests.hint: Workers carry food home and haul corpses.

quests.title: Send a forage party
quests.hint: Missions → Forage. Send a few Workers into the wilds and see what they find.

quests.title: Send out a Scout
quests.hint: Raise a Scout, then open Missions and tap a scent in your patch: the wild nest, a neighbor, or the wilds at the edge.

quests.title: Raid the wild nest
quests.hint: Every patch has a nest of wild ants: the red scent. Scout it first, check the battle preview, then send Minor Soldiers. Bring a few Workers to carry the loot home.
